Excluded, decided on #1774. Reached via the Dataverse API (doi:10.7910/DVN/1KDJTZ) -- access is not the problem. The record holds a single file with 15 columns: Age, Education Level, Nationality and bare CFC1-CFC12. No codebook, no questionnaire, no wording anywhere, and the IRW dictionary row is empty (no Description, no Reference, no DOI). The only evidence tying the table to the Consideration of Future Consequences scale is the column prefix. Shipping it would mean assigning canonical CFC wording (Strathman et al. 1994) to CFC1-CFC12 by assumed publication order with nothing in the record stating that order, no author or paper to check against, and no statistical route since all 12 items share one 1-5 scale -- so a wrong ordering would be undetectable and entirely plausible, the gilbert_meta_35 failure mode. Weaker than the galindo_2023_* tables excluded earlier, which at least had a named study and a code-to-subscale map. Retryable if a paper for this dataset ever surfaces.
